import urllib.request
import socket

def test():
    query = "hello world"
    host = 'http://www.bing.com/search?q=%s&go=&qs=n&sk=&sc=8-13&first=10' % query
    response = urllib.request.urlopen(host)
    return response

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.bind(("localhost", 8080))
    sock.listen(1)
    conn, addr = sock.accept()
    data = b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.com\r\nUser-Agent: Mozilla/5.0\r\n\r\n"
    conn.sendall(data)
    response = b""
    for chunk in conn.recv(1024):
        response += chunk
    print(response.decode())
    conn.close()
```

import urllib.request
import asyncio

def test():
    query = "hello world"
    host = 'http://www.bing.com/search?q=%s&go=&qs=n&sk=&sc=8-13&first=10' % query
    response = urllib.request.urlopen(host)
    return response

async def f():
    server = await asyncio.start_server(
        lambda r, w: (
            lambda rr, rw: rw.write(await r.read(100))
            or [await rw.drain(), w.write(await rr.read(100)), await w.drain()]
        )(*await asyncio.open_connection("remote.example.com", 80)),
        "localhost",
        8080,
    )
    async with server:
        await server.serve_forever()

asyncio.run(f())
```
